test_list_get: test the list.get function to retrieve elements by index with null_on_oob control
test_list_gather: test the list.gather function to retrieve multiple elements by index list with out-of-bounds handling
test_list_contains: test the list.contains function to check if a value exists in each list element
test_list_concat: test the list.concat function to concatenate two list columns or list with scalar values
test_list_join: test the list.join function to join list elements into a string with configurable separator and null handling
test_list_slice: test the list.slice function to extract sublists with offset and length parameters
test_list_unique: test the list.unique function to remove duplicate elements from each list with optional order preservation
test_list_to_struct: test the list.to_struct function to convert a list column into a struct with custom field names
test_list_to_array: test the list.to_array function to convert a list column into a fixed-size array
test_list_filter: test the list.filter function to filter list elements using a boolean expression
